about: JavaScript held for 500 ms while something moves (docs/adr/0067-the-ui-thread.mdx; sample/StallProbe.tsx): what moves on the UI thread goes on being drawn, as on React Native's Android and iOS and on a Mac's render server. A 3 s linear Animated.timing on the native driver, a 3 s Reanimated withTiming (a worklet on the UI runtime), each with JavaScript held 500 ms 1 s in, and a touchpad's glide with JavaScript held 30 ms into its momentum: the window's frames go on through the block, and each motion's own (the native driver's props, Reanimated's commits, the glide's offset); the held glide goes as far as the free one. Every run holds half the block's refreshes drawn and no gap of 6 refreshes (a JavaScript holding the frames up leaves a gap of the whole block); perf-stall.json, the same in the gate's timing phase, holds a frame each refresh (--speed-budgets: the gaps' 95th percentile within 1.5 refreshes, none over 2).

steps.name: Animated's native driver: a 3 s linear timing, JavaScript held 500 ms a second in; the box moves on through the block, a frame each refresh
Reanimated: a 3 s linear withTiming, JavaScript held 500 ms a second in; the worklet runs on through the block on the UI runtime, its commits mounted each refresh
a touchpad's flick, JavaScript free: the list glides its distance
the same flick, JavaScript held 500 ms 30 ms into the glide: the list glides on through the block, a frame each refresh, as far as the free glide
